## Essay use

Technical foundation for energy functions over configurations, inference as finding low-energy configurations, and learning as shaping an energy landscape. It anchors the EBM research vector before Bimba/attractor resonance is proposed.

**Claim boundary:** an EBM's scalar energy is a defined technical function over configurations. A Bimba mapping to psychic energy, value, or musical consonance must specify its variables, energy function, inference, learning rule, and empirical test; the shared word supplies no equivalence by itself.

<a id="lecun-et-al-2006-energy-based-learning-q001"></a>
## Passage card — `lecun-et-al-2006-energy-based-learning-q001` — Energy as scalar compatibility over declared configurations
^lecun-et-al-2006-energy-based-learning-q001

> “Energy-Based Models (EBMs) capture dependencies by associating a scalar energy (a measure of compatibility) to each configuration of the variables. Inference, i.e., making a prediction or decision, consists in setting the value of observed variables and finding values of the remaining variables that minimize the energy. Learning consists in finding an energy function that associates low energies to correct values of the remaining variables, and higher energies to incorrect values.”

- **Locator:** v1.0 PDF §1 “Introduction: Energy-Based Models,” printed p. 1; PDF pp. 1–2/59.
- **Status:** quotation-ready.
- **Verification:** Luna acquisition agent and coordinator, 2026-07-14; manually transcribed and visually checked against the typeset author-hosted PDF; OCR uncertainty: none.
- **Source relation:** extracted primary technical formulation.
- **Evidential action:** supports.
- **Argument function:** candidate energy/configuration mechanism.
- **Consumers:** [[39-s5-p2-j-space]]; [[41-s5-p4-bimba-energy-fields]]; [[42-s5-p5-research-vectors]]; [[section-rooms/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood|Objective Internality]]; [[section-rooms/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field|Arche-Topos as Differential Field]]; [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map]]; [[section-rooms/arguments/A31-Deferential-Intelligence|Deferential Intelligence]]; [[A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First|Computational Vimarśa]].
- **Use boundary:** establishes a technical compatibility landscape over declared variables; it does not establish a total world, phenomenality, value, psychic energy, Bimba, or QL.

<a id="lecun-et-al-2006-energy-based-learning-q002"></a>
## Passage card — `lecun-et-al-2006-energy-based-learning-q002` — Technical energy distinguished from training loss
^lecun-et-al-2006-energy-based-learning-q002

> “Functions of this type are given different names in different technical communities; they may be called contrast functions, value functions, or negative log-likelihood functions. In the following, we will use the term energy function and denote it E(Y, X). A distinction should be made between the energy function, which is minimized by the inference process, and the loss functional (introduced in Section 2), which is minimized by the learning process.”

- **Locator:** v1.0 PDF §1.1 “Energy-Based Inference,” printed p. 3; PDF p. 3/59.
- **Status:** quotation-ready.
- **Verification:** Luna acquisition agent and coordinator, 2026-07-14; manually transcribed and visually checked against the typeset author-hosted PDF; OCR uncertainty: none.
- **Source relation:** extracted primary technical formulation.
- **Evidential action:** qualifies.
- **Argument function:** terminological and inference/learning scope limitation.
- **Consumers:** [[39-s5-p2-j-space]]; [[41-s5-p4-bimba-energy-fields]]; [[42-s5-p5-research-vectors]]; [[section-rooms/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood|Agent Subjectivity Must Remain Open]]; [[section-rooms/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit|Immutable Gap and Meta-Sign]].
- **Use boundary:** establishes a stipulated scalar name and its distinction from a loss functional; it does not license equivalence with psychic energy, value, consciousness, Bimba, or QL.
